equation_policy: Use supervisor-confirmed Eqs. 14 to 19 as written; no physical model corrections.
selection_policy: Use the supervisor values received on 2026-11-16. Map the received notation to the equation fields and derive Da only from the supplied M=1/Da definition.
lock_policy: Do not change or tune these values automatically. A change requires explicit user or supervisor confirmation and a dated record. Debug cases must be separate from this locked target.

supervisor_confirmation.source: User message relaying values directly from the supervisor and asking to lock them.
supervisor_confirmation.notation_aliases_basis: Notation aliases recorded with user approval of this update; these three mappings were not spelled out in the received block.

derived_parameters.Da: 1/M = 1/5 = 0.2, computed from the confirmed M and its supplied definition. Da was not supplied directly.

unmapped_symbols.H: Value is confirmed in received_values. No scalar H coefficient appears in Eqs. 14 to 19. Do not substitute it for the derivative vector H in the reference setup.
unmapped_symbols.Prm: Value is confirmed in received_values. No Prm coefficient appears in Eqs. 14 to 19. Its relation to the older Pm notation is not confirmed; do not substitute it for Pr, Pe or Lb.

selection_notes.Pr: The supervisor's new Pr=8.8 supersedes the scanned sheet's Pr=6.8.
selection_notes.delta_star: Supplied dt=0 is a known zero, not a missing value.
selection_notes.theta_w: Supplied tw=0.2 is locked. Check temperature reconstruction and the effective thermal coefficient on any later computed solution.
selection_notes.epsilon: Store ep=0.1 as epsilon using the approved notation alias. The separate conditional temperature-definition relation remains unconfirmed and must not replace this value.
selection_notes.lambda_m: Supplied L=0.5 means lambda_m, not the numerical far endpoint L.
selection_notes.Da: Use 1/M=0.2. The supplied scalar M is neither beta_m nor the local highest-derivative matrix M.
selection_notes.definitions: The open B, Lb, temperature and fw definitions remain questions in docs/questions-for-supervisor.md. Receipt of numbers does not settle them or validate a solution.

excluded_or_unresolved_sheet_symbols.Pm: The older sheet's two Pm-looking lines were identified as magnetic Prandtl number. Pm does not appear in the specified equations. Do not infer that the new Prm spelling has the same meaning without confirmation.
excluded_or_unresolved_sheet_symbols.M: The older crossed-out line remains part of the scanned history. The 2026-11-16 message now explicitly defines the supplied M as 1/Da, not beta_m.
excluded_or_unresolved_sheet_symbols.crossed_out_Nr_or_Nb: The crossed-out sheet notation supplied no usable number. Nr and Nb now come from the 2026-11-16 message.

auxiliary_debug_case.purpose: Optional numerical starting case only. Create a separate case before applying overrides; never change the locked supervisor target.
auxiliary_debug_case.source: Researcher-proposed debug values recorded on 2026-11-12, not supervisor values.
auxiliary_debug_case.all_other_parameters: Inherit the confirmed target coefficients. Software tests and reference checks are still pending.
